formats.ogg: same Opus in Ogg — drop-in for existing engine extensionFor() which requests .ogg
formats.mp3: LAME V2 44.1k fallback (not gapless: loop via Web Audio with loopStart=576/sr)

loudness_method: EBU R128 integrated via ffmpeg ebur128; clips <1 s measured padded with 0.5 s silence each side; true peak ceiling -4 dBTP (4x oversampled limiter) so encodes stay ≤ -3.6 dBFS

ambient-loop.trigger: first user gesture after sound toggle ON; 2.5 s fade-in; runs whole scroll; duck -4 dB under one-shots
ambient-loop.source: ambient_a 4-58s, despiked x2 (+3dB over 3s median), HP60, 3s xfade

boot-stinger.hook: existing hook boot-stinger (engine.onLock; impact = loudest sample)
boot-stinger.trigger: loader 0-3.5 s; impact sample at 3.513 s = loader resolve at 3.5 s
boot-stinger.source: loader_b; hum 0.15-2.72s atempo 0.751 + ramp -14→-9 dB; hit from 2.72s

hover.trigger: pointerenter on any interactive clay object/nav item; debounce ≥120 ms

shatter.hook: existing hook shatter (engine.onBurst start) — reused for stack sliding apart
shatter.trigger: layers stack explode, scroll ~24-30 s (stack-explode.json start)

reassemble.hook: existing hook reassemble (engine.onBurst end-aligned) — stack slides back + settle tock
reassemble.trigger: stack re-closes / scroll-back; buffer end aligned to return end

tock.trigger: glaze ball contact / collision (velocity-scaled gain), also loss-landscape ball landing ~39-48 s

drag-loop.trigger: start on drag start, gain ∝ pointer speed (0-1), 120 ms fade out on release

roll-loop.trigger: glaze ball rolling, loss landscape 39-48 s; gain & playbackRate 0.9-1.1 ∝ ball speed

pulse.trigger: pulse runs up the bone spine, layers section 19.5-30 s (each pulse)

dive.trigger: product dive into FieldRelay/Counter/Roster room (attention section 30-39 s click); <1.2 s, also on Esc-back at 0.7 gain

mix.default: sound OFF; visible toggle (top-right, speaker icon + label); persist choice in localStorage but still require a gesture to start
mix.ambient: starts only on first user gesture after toggle ON; fade-in 2.5 s; gain 0.5 on top of -30 LUFS file
mix.ceiling: master DynamicsCompressor (threshold -6, ratio 4) + never exceed gain 1.0; no cue louder than -20 LUFS file level
mix.loops: decode Opus into AudioBuffer, AudioBufferSourceNode.loop=true (never <audio loop>)
